phase1e_added_sources.author: L. Masanes, M. P. Müller
phase1e_added_sources.title: A derivation of quantum theory from physical requirements
phase1e_added_sources.claims: derives full quantum formalism (including state space and probability/structure) from five physical requirements; reconstruction of quantum formalism from operational-type axioms
phase1e_added_sources.note: probability-rule reconstruction status is a PHASE-2A question; not adjudicated here

phase1e_added_sources.author: D. Dürr, S. Goldstein, N. Zanghì
phase1e_added_sources.title: Quantum Equilibrium and the Origin of Absolute Uncertainty
phase1e_added_sources.claims: Bohmian mechanics; appearance of randomness precisely as given by rho=|psi|^2; effective wave function of subsystem as crucial ingredient; deterministic theory producing quantum-formalism phenomenology
phase1e_added_sources.note: separate evidence objects required for guidance dynamics / equivariance / rho=|psi|^2 / typicality in PHASE 2A

phase1e_added_sources.author: A. Valentini, H. Westman
phase1e_added_sources.title: Dynamical Origin of Quantum Probabilities
phase1e_added_sources.identifier: arXiv:quant-ph/0403034v2; Proc. R. Soc. Lond. A 461, 253-272 (2005)
phase1e_added_sources.claims: Born rule arises dynamically; non-standard distributions rho != |psi|^2 relax toward |psi|^2; coarse-grained H-function (= -relative entropy of rho w.r.t. |psi|^2) decreases approx exponentially
phase1e_added_sources.note: nonequilibrium counterexample class kept distinct from R6

phase1e_added_sources.author: G. C. Ghirardi, A. Rimini, T. Weber
phase1e_added_sources.title: Unified dynamics for microscopic and macroscopic systems
phase1e_added_sources.claims: modified dynamics postulated for microscopic systems; forbids far-apart spatial superpositions of macroscopic objects; standard QM (micro) and classical behavior (macro) derived consistently; Fokker-Planck description for macroscopic CM; 'provides the basis for a conceptually appealing description of quantum measurement'
phase1e_added_sources.note: stochastic law itself and its probability structure extracted in PHASE 2A; DP-R0-01 remains contextual only

phase1e_added_sources.author: C. Sebens, S. Carroll
phase1e_added_sources.title: Self-Locating Uncertainty and the Origin of Probability in Everettian Quantum Mechanics
